hypothesis: Without replacing any date or event, treating an incomplete or over-12-hour-stale 18-hour market vector as an observable real-time NO_TRADE condition leaves a balanced feasibility sample large enough for a bounded NBM join pilot.
disclosure: This corrective criterion was designed after the original 90% coverage gate failed at 85%; it cannot supersede or erase that failure.

eligibility_rule.eligible: all bucket prices exist at or before cutoff and maximum staleness is no more than 43,200 seconds
eligibility_rule.ineligible: NO_TRADE; retain row and reason but exclude from forecast/market scoring

decision_rule.pass: Permit NBM retrieval for all frozen dates and final scoring only on pre-decision price-eligible events; preserve NO_TRADE rows.
decision_rule.fail: Stop this pilot and redesign prospective collection coverage.
